title: The ship that sailed with no one aboard
caption: December 1872: the Mary Celeste is found drifting near the Azores. Cargo intact, six months of food, belongings untouched. The lifeboat and all ten people: gone. What do you think happened? 👇
notes: Off-brand: made before the channel was redefined around The Great Mystery project. Delete this folder or keep it for reference.
